label: Flower
depicts: Tulip blossom on a stem with one leaf and a curved ground line
use_when: Use when the interface wants a tulip style flower rather than a flat petal rosette.
avoid_when: Do not use for circular petal flowers when the stem and ground line are visible.

label: Flower
depicts: Flower outline with six petal loops around a round center ring
use_when: Use when the interface wants a simple front facing flower made from evenly spaced petals.
avoid_when: Do not use for stemmed or spiral blossoms when the visible form is a six petal rosette.

label: Flower
depicts: Flower outline with four rounded petal loops around a small center ring
use_when: Use when the interface wants a flower made from four overlapping rounded petal loops.
avoid_when: Do not use for the six petal daisy or spiral blossom when the flower has four looping petals.

label: Flower
depicts: Three petal tulip blossom on a stem with two side leaves
use_when: Use when the interface wants a stemmed flower with open side leaves and a three petal crown.
avoid_when: Do not use for the simpler tulip icon when the extra side leaves need to stay visible.

label: Flower
depicts: Flower outline with many rounded petal loops around a small center dot
use_when: Use when the interface wants the most ornate rounded blossom in this flower family.
avoid_when: Do not use for simpler four or six petal flowers when the many swirling petals matter.
